docs.title: Documentation
docs.workflowDescription: Each cell represents one Artbead. Create a scheme, choose a color from the tray, then draw cell by cell.

create.title: Create a scheme
create.body: Use File to create a blank scheme, import an image, or paste a share code. Set the Pegboard size when creating a blank scheme; imported images use the closest available Artbead colors.

chooseColor.title: Choose a color
chooseColor.body: After a scheme opens, click an Artbead in the tray on the left. The current color, code, and usage count appear below the palette.

draw.title: Edit cell by cell
draw.body: Choose Pencil, Eraser, Fill, or a selection tool. Edits save automatically; you can also click Save or press Ctrl / ⌘ + S.

assemble.title: Review and assemble
assemble.body: Use View to toggle rulers, the grid, the coarse grid, and the Pegboard background. When finished, choose Start assembling from More for a read-only pickup list, or choose Export drawing to preview and download a PNG.

docs.boardNote: Rulers show row and column numbers; the bottom zoom control resets to 100%. Wheel to pan, Shift + wheel to pan sideways, and Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel to zoom. Middle-drag or Space + left-drag also pans.
docs.toolsDescription: The first eight buttons are for drawing and selecting. Each card lists its operation, selection modifiers, and tool shortcut.

tools.colorSelect: The first click only switches to Color select; click the active tool again to open its selection-mode menu, or right-click the tool to open the menu directly. Opening it by right-click does not switch tools immediately; the tool switches only after you choose a specific mode. Click any cell to select every cell with the same color across the Pegboard, including empty cells. Ctrl / ⌘ + left temporarily adds, Alt + left subtracts, Ctrl / ⌘ + right selects the opposite region, and Alt + right intersects. Del deletes the selection; right-click clears it.
tools.magicWand: The first click only switches to Magic wand; click the active tool again or right-click it to open the selection-mode menu. A right-click does not switch tools immediately; the tool switches only after you choose a specific mode. Click a colored Artbead to select a contiguous region of similar colors, and adjust the match threshold in the menu. Clicking an empty cell selects contiguous empty cells and ignores the threshold. Selection modifiers match Color select: Ctrl / ⌘ + left adds, Alt + left subtracts, Ctrl / ⌘ + right selects the opposite region, and Alt + right intersects. Del deletes the selection; right-click clears it.
tools.select: The first click only switches to Rectangle select; click the active tool again or right-click it to open the selection-mode menu. A right-click does not switch tools immediately; the tool switches only after you choose a specific mode. Drag with the left button to create a rectangular selection, and hold Shift while dragging for a square. Ctrl / ⌘ + left adds, Alt + left subtracts, Ctrl / ⌘ + right selects the opposite region, and Alt + right intersects. Del deletes the selection, right-click clears it, Ctrl / ⌘ + C copies, and Ctrl / ⌘ + V pastes.
tools.move: Available when there is a selection or temporary paste layer. Drag the selection to move its contents. Del discards the current move or paste layer, right-click clears the selection, and switching tools merges the temporary layer.
tools.colorPicker: Open the picker menu, choose Artbead picker or Background picker, then click a cell. The first reads an existing Artbead; the second samples a reference image and matches the nearest Artbead.
tools.pencil: Hold the left button and drag to paint the selected Artbead color into each visited cell.
tools.eraser: Hold the left button and drag to clear Artbeads from each visited cell.
tools.fill: With no selection, click to fill the whole Pegboard. With a selection, click inside to fill the selection or outside to fill everything except the selection. Every fill is undoable.

docs.actionsDescription: The rest of the toolbar provides reference images, selection clipboard history, undo history, and more actions.

actionDescriptions.reference: Open the reference-image list to import, select, remove, or press-and-hold to reorder images. With an image selected, drag to move, drag a corner to resize, or drag the top handle to rotate. Hold Shift to lock proportions or rotate in 15° steps.
actionDescriptions.copy: Copy the Artbeads and full palette inside the current selection to the recent clipboard.
actionDescriptions.paste: Paste the most recent selection into the visible center of the current Pegboard and enter the movable state.
actionDescriptions.undo: Undo the most recent Pegboard or reference-image edit.
actionDescriptions.redo: Restore the most recently undone edit.
actionDescriptions.save: Save the current scheme immediately. Normal edits also save automatically.
actionDescriptions.more: Start assembling saves the scheme first and opens the read-only assembly view. Export drawing opens a dedicated export page for downloading a PNG. Export share code copies the current Pegboard data to the system clipboard.

docs.selectionDescription: Color Select, Magic Wand, and Rectangle Select share the same selection modes. The first click only switches tools; click the active tool again to open its mode menu. You can also right-click any selection tool to open its menu directly. A right-click does not switch the current tool; the tool switches only after you choose a specific mode.

selectionModes.replace: The new selection replaces the old one. This is the default mode.
selectionModes.union: Add the new selection to the existing selection.
selectionModes.subtract: Remove the new selection from the existing selection.
selectionModes.xor: Keep cells that belong to only one selection and remove the overlap.
selectionModes.intersect: Keep only the overlap between the new and existing selections.

docs.shortcutsDescription: This section centralizes tool switching, editing, view navigation, and selection operations. The former workspace status-bar tool tips are consolidated here. Shortcuts work while the Pegboard has focus; when the cursor is in an input, select box, or editable text, the keys are used for text entry instead.

docs.shortcutTip: On macOS, use ⌘ instead of Ctrl. Some browsers or operating systems may reserve individual combinations; click the Pegboard first if a shortcut does not respond.
